question: What claim is made about the measure and status of this Kaula teaching?
premises: This teaching is identified as Kaula.
It is said to be supreme-arisen.
It is said indeed to be of measure ten crores.
inference: This Kaula teaching is presented as supreme-arisen and as having a measure of ten crores.
uncertainties: Whether 'measure' denotes extent, number of texts, or mantric measure is not specified here.
plain_english: Indeed, this Kaula teaching, supreme-arisen, is of measure ten crores.
